notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: the best new Steam games you haven t heard of
notes.notes:
Welcome back to Unknown Pleasures, our weekly* search for five splendid but under-reported new games released on Steam over the past seven days.

This week: firelight survival, bootleg Podracing, Mario vs Super Crate Box, monkey-free Monkey Ball and lava lamp simulation. (more…)

notes.title: Game Update 4th April
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

The team is pleased to announce the latest update for Breakneck which includes:

[u][b]Research Zone[/b][/u]
A brand new environment has been added into the game to provide new challenges for players. Master these new zones to claim the highest score!

[u][b]Controller Bug Fix[/b][/u]
The game should now save your controller binding settings.

[u][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/u]
Various bug fixes in zones and graphics improvements.

Hope you are now ready to jump back into some epic racing action!

Best regards,
PikPok
